responsibility_name: maintain comfortable indoor temperature and humidity

evidence.evidence_text: If the house temperature is not higher than 17°, TURN UP the heating and CHECK the air humidity level, if humidity <35% ACTIVATE the humidifier

coding.rationale: Evidence mandates heating and humidification when temperature and humidity cross low thresholds; failure is occupant discomfort.

responsibility_name: maintain comfortable indoor temperature when occupied

evidence.evidence_text: WHEN house temperature exceeds 24° AND someone is home TURN the air conditioning ON

coding.rationale: Cooling is triggered only when someone is home and temperature exceeds a threshold, maintaining thermal comfort for present occupants.

responsibility_name: maintain comfortable warmth for occupants in cold rooms

evidence.evidence_text: When the user is detected in a room, if the temperature is below 18 degrees, turn on the heating, the electric blanket and the dehumidifier

coding.rationale: Heating measures activate when a user is present in a cold room, maintaining warmth for the detected occupant.

evidence.evidence_text: When the smoke detector detects cigarette smoke in the house and if the windows are closed, the windows open or the air purification system is switched on.
If the windows in the house are closed for more than 24h and the air purifier detects high levels of CO2, the windows open and the purifier starts working sanitizing the air

coding.rationale: Ventilation and purification respond to smoke and high CO2, guarding household health against airborne hazards; context mixes hazard and threshold triggers.

responsibility_name: maintain morning shower comfort with heating

evidence.evidence_text: While the user is in the shower and the time is between 7:00 and 9:00 TURN ON the heating in the bathroom and SEND the news of the day

coding.rationale: Bathroom heating during a fixed morning shower window maintains thermal comfort for the showering resident.

responsibility_name: send the news of the day during the shower

evidence.evidence_text: While the user is in the shower and the time is between 7:00 and 9:00 TURN ON the heating in the bathroom and SEND the news of the day

coding.rationale: News must be delivered during the scheduled morning shower window; failure means the resident misses the briefing, an inconvenience.

evidence.evidence_text: When the humidity in the kitchen is above 70% and the window is closed, turn on the whirlpool

coding.rationale: Excessive kitchen humidity risks mold and material damage; ventilation guards the property when humidity crosses a high threshold.

responsibility_name: maintain warm bed before nighttime use

evidence.evidence_text: When it is 21:00 and if the room temperature is below 15°, then turn on the bed warmer

coding.rationale: Bed warming at 21:00 prepares a warm bed ahead of nighttime sleep when the room is cold.

responsibility_name: maintain warm indoor temperature when home

evidence.evidence_text: IF the temperature is below 18°C WHILE the user is at home, CLOSE all windows and TURN ON the radiators.

coding.rationale: Windows close and radiators run when temperature drops while the user is home, maintaining warmth for present occupants.

evidence.evidence_text: If a radiator does not work, the boiler is reset and the water pressure is increased.

coding.rationale: Boiler reset and pressure increase recover heating after a radiator failure event; failure manifests as lost heating comfort.

responsibility_name: Support midday cooking by preheating the oven

evidence.evidence_text: When the user enters the kitchen and the time is between 12:00 - 14:00, the oven turns on.

coding.rationale: Oven preheats during the midday cooking window when the user enters the kitchen, preparing for cooking; failure causes delay and inconvenience.

evidence.evidence_text: When the user turns on the heating, if the temperature detected in the solar panels is above 40 degrees, deactivate the boiler and activate the heating with the solar panels

coding.rationale: Switching from boiler to solar when solar heat is available optimizes energy use; failure wastes boiler energy.

responsibility_name: Ensure occupants are alerted when mail arrives

evidence.evidence_text: When the mailbox sensor detects content, a notification light will turn on inside the house.

coding.rationale: An in-home alert on mailbox content detection keeps residents aware of mail arrival; missed alerts cause inconvenience.

responsibility_name: Ensure visitors are acknowledged when nobody is home

evidence.evidence_text: When someone rings the doorbell but no one is at home, a notification arrives on the phone that warns of the presence of the guest and the bell speaker signals that no one can open.

coding.rationale: When nobody is home, the visitor receives an acknowledgment and the resident is notified; failure leaves the visitor unattended.

responsibility_name: monitor door visitors when family away

evidence.evidence_text: WHEN someone rings the intercom IF family NOT at home AND IF devices in «do not disturb» mode SHOW surveillance camera video and VIEW message on doorbell display

coding.rationale: Camera video and doorbell messaging let the absent family monitor and respond to door visitors, guarding home security while away.
